newsitem.title: BRAZIL: DynaMotive says signs letter with sugar co.
newsitem.headline: DynaMotive says signs letter with sugar co.

text.p: DynaMotive Technologies Corp said Tuesday it signed a letter of understanding with a Brazillian sugar processing company to produce fuel and chemicals at its BioMass Refinery.
A DynaMotive spokesman said the name of the sugar company is being witheld until the deal is signed.
DynaMotive said the two companies plan to form a joint venture company to commercialize the Brazillian refinery.
DynaMotive said the Brazillian refinery will convert organic wastes such as sugar cane leaves and bagasse into fuels and chemicals.
A Dynamotive spokesman said they have the potential to use 1.4 million tons of waste a year. He said he could not immediately quantify the amount the company will actually use.
The company said the letter of understanding calls for a due diligence period of 60 days.
